thread:
pagerduty: INCIDENT triggered — CedarBridge (dedicated pool) high 5xx rate during staged deploy. Severity: P1. Paging: oncall@sre. Link: https://pd.redwood.example/inc/CB-4821 :rotating_light:

katie: Paging SRE — CedarBridge dedicated pool is seeing a spike in 5xx right after the staged deploy landed to canary batch 3. Noticed traffic didn't fall back automatically. tagging @michael @deepa for infra + routing.

michael: on it. pulling graphs now. can you confirm which artifact rolled?

deploy-bot: Deployment event: staged-deploy cedarbridge-service
- artifact: rbw-cedar-2.3.7
- canary batch: 3 of 5
- started: 2025-11-09T14:08:12Z
- failing hosts: 6/20
- error rate (canary group): 12.4% -> baseline 0.2%

sam: quick look at logs from one of the failing workers:
```
2025-11-09T14:09:05Z [worker-6] ERROR model-infer - KVCache miss mismatch: expected seq=6789 got seq=0
2025-11-09T14:09:05Z [worker-6] ERROR oom: process killed by OOM
stack: /usr/local/bin/model-worker
```

deepa: that log smells like a model artifact/runtime mismatch — KV cache format change or bad kernel selection. safest short-term move: isolate CedarBridge tenants onto the fallback instance and pinback deploy to previous artifact (rbw-cedar-2.3.6).

katie: @alex any customer-side impact reports? are they on live prod traffic?

alex: CedarBridge is running live traffic in dedicated VPC. We already got 2 support tickets flagged as interruptions to inference. They're on a call with their infra lead. They want a rollback ASAP. I'll prepare a customer note once we confirm a mitigation path.

michael: agree with pinback. two steps: 1) quarantine CedarBridge tenant routing to fallback pool to stop exposure, 2) pinback artifact on dedicated pool. I'll coordinate with deploy.

katie: run the pinback command (michael if you want me to run I can). Keep me posted. :eyes:

michael: running pinback now:
```
# pinback to previous artifact
redwood-deploy rollback --tenant cedarbridge --pool dedicated-cedarpool --to-artifact rbw-cedar-2.3.6 --reason "KV cache mismatch in 2.3.7"
```

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Initiating rollback job id: rbw-rollback-18472. Rolling canary groups back to rbw-cedar-2.3.6. Expected completion ~2m.

observability-bot: Alert: routing rule created — cedarbridge -> dedicated-cedarpool-fallback. Rule id: rt-9834. Traffic shifted at 14:12:34Z.

katie: rollback started. also applied tenant isolation rule to prevent writes to canary nodes.

deploy-bot: Rollback job rbw-rollback-18472 completed. All canary and primary nodes now running rbw-cedar-2.3.6.

observability-bot: Metrics update (1m window):
- CedarBridge 5xx rate: 11.9% -> 1.1% after routing change -> 0.3% after rollback
- p99 latency: 850ms -> 420ms

sam: confirming logs on worker-6 show no OOM after rollback. KVCache messages gone from tail.

deepa: leaving the isolation rule in place until we validate a proper model artifact fix. I'll open a follow-up RFC for model runtime compatibility test and a canary gating check.

katie: customer notified. Alex sent the brief: "We detected an anomaly during staged deploy and have reverted to last known-good. Working on full validation; we will follow up with timeline."

michael: quick postmortem checklist: capture failing artifact (rbw-cedar-2.3.7) bundle, access logs from failing hosts, reproduce with the canary harness, add a gating test for KV cache format. Assign to runtime team.

deepa: assigned RFC / ticket INF-2749, tagging @sam for reproduction, @michael for rollout gating, @research for kernel selection.

katie: handing off active incident to @deepa for remediation and validation. I'm unpaging and will update the incident ticket with timeline + customer comms. Oncall handover: 14:20Z -> deepa (next).

alex: customer ack: they appreciate the quick rollback. asked for ETA on a permanent fix — I'll coordinate on next steps once we have root cause.

katie: closing the immediate paging loop. keeping the isolation rule and rollback documented in the incident ticket. If anything regresses, ping the thread or re-page. :thumbsup:
